description: Stirling efficiency: eta = f_carnot * eta_carnot(T_h, T_c), with part-load loss curve and minimum load.

engine.name: Generic kinematic alpha-type Stirling engine (micro-CHP scale)
engine.source: Kongtragool & Wongwises (2003) Renewable & Sustainable Energy Reviews 7, 131-154; Cinar et al. (2005) Appl. Thermal Eng. 25, 1845-1854.

P_rated.note: Rated electrical output (~9 kW micro-CHP, e.g. WhisperGen)

a_partload.note: Part-load loss coefficient: eta = eta_design*(1 - a*(1-PLR)^2)
